name: Praising The Lord
overview: Scripture calls believers to praise the Lord for His mighty acts and His excellent greatness, emphasizing that all who have breath are to join in this worship. The Psalms urge joyful praise as an appropriate response to God's unchanging nature, exemplified in Jesus Christ who is the same yesterday, today, and forever. Additionally, the New Testament encourages expressing praise through prayer and singing, especially in times of joy and affliction, highlighting praise as both a heartfelt and active expression of faith.
